notes.title: How to choose 'ENGLISH'
notes.notes:
first, click '옵션'
second, check the box '텍스트언어' and click '영어'
'영어' means 'english'

notes.title: Streaming Guide
notes.notes:
Hello, this is JoonsPictures.

Recently, cases of infringement of our copyright by editing and uploading various endings of <MADE: Interactive Movie-01. Run Away> on the YouTube platform have occurred frequently.
This is a part that not only infringes on our copyright, but may also cause problems with the portrait rights of actresses/actors, so please pay close attention from streamers.
Please be careful not to cause legal problems.

Our game is a story game, so please disclose only one ending when streaming.
As many streamers care about copyright protection, we ask for your continued interest in the future.

Thank you to all streamers playing <MADE>.

Thank you.
